name: Omni Hilton Head Oceanfront Resort
positioning: Oceanfront resort on Hilton Head Island in South Carolina, part of the Palmetto Dunes Oceanfront Resort Community, with private beach access, several pools and championship golf
best_for: Families wanting kids' pools, a kids camp and rooms with kitchenettes and sofa beds
Golfers and tennis players wanting courses and courts close at hand
Beach lovers wanting oceanfront balconies and private beach access

facts.text: The resort overlooks the Atlantic Ocean, a beach and three championship golf courses.
The resort is part of the Palmetto Dunes Oceanfront Resort Community.
The resort sits on sugar-sand beaches.
Guests have access to 11 miles of lagoon trails, tennis courts, private beach access, swimming pools and wellness areas.
Guest accommodations are decorated with a neutral palette augmented by ocean views and splashes of color.
Room options feature sofa beds, kitchenettes and additional living space for families.
The resort offers 54 holes of championship golf.
The resort has full-sized tennis and pickleball courts.
The resort offers family-friendly resort activities and a kids camp.
Island activities include biking, tennis, golf and kayaking.
There are five dining outlets: two full-service restaurants, a grab-and-go market and two pool bars.
The poolside Buoy Bar brings tiki vibes to the lowcountry.

highlights.text: The Luxury Suite offers dedicated living and sleeping quarters along with an oceanfront balcony.
The resort has an adult pool, two family pools and a kids' splash pad.
Ocean Tides Spa offers treatments from facials and body treatments to massages and manicures.
Chef's Playground is a multi-course culinary journey of surprise dishes paired with wines or mocktails.

considerations.text: Guests must be 21 or older to check in.
The resort is about 6 miles from Hilton Head Airport and about 42 miles from Savannah/Hilton Head International Airport.
The resort is pet friendly for dogs, with a one-time non-refundable pet fee per reservation for up to one dog.
